unresolved: No seed/repetition count is stated anywhere for the final trained MNIST/CIFAR10 models -- each headline result (Tables 1-2) appears to come from a single trained network per architecture, not repeated runs, so n_seeds is left null rather than assumed 1.

n_models (3) is an approximation: 1 final MNIST CNN (32/64 conv filters + 1024 FC) and 2 CIFAR10 ResNet variants (base and 10x-wider); the capacity-sweep experiments (Figure 4) additionally train many more architectures at doubling filter counts, which are not counted here as they are an ablation, not final reported models.

n_eval_types (5) is an approximation covering: white-box attack accuracy (PGD/FGSM/CW/CW+), black-box transfer accuracy (from A', A_nat, architecture B), accuracy vs epsilon sweep (Figure 6), l2-bounded vs l_inf-bounded attack accuracy, and network-capacity-vs-robustness analysis (Figure 4) -- the paper does not itself enumerate 'evaluation types' as a fixed list.

n_baselines (2) counts natural (no adversarial) training and FGSM adversarial training as the comparison training regimes against the paper's own PGD adversarial training; it does not count the various attack source models (A, A', A_nat, B) as baselines since those are attackers, not competing defense methods.
No formal statistical test or confidence interval is reported anywhere in the main text or appendix; all reported numbers are point accuracies from single evaluation runs.
